recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Treat FHIR-13973 as applied; future representation changes for profile-element should be handled as new conformance/tooling work.

reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. ElementDefinition.type.profile documentation points to profile-element for profiling a backbone element, profiling.html demonstrates the Composition.section use case, and the extension definition exists in the FHIR Extension Pack.
